verdict.rationale: Decagon documents that its agent can take real actions to complete customer tasks, through no-code integrations that 'retrieve data, take action' and Browser Actions that 'complete a task inside any system'. That is a first-party basis for end-to-end resolution rather than mere deflection. However, the pack has no resolution-rate figures, no metric separating resolutions from deflections or bounces, and no evidence of what share of conversations are actually resolved. Missing for 10: documented resolution-rate metric distinct from deflection, customer or independent evidence of a meaningful resolved share, reporting that defines and tracks true resolutions.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent fully resolves a meaningful share of conversations end-to-end — measured as resolutions, not mere deflections or bounces

citations.quote: They ensure your agent can retrieve data, take action, and handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels with no custom code required.
It extends the agent you've already built so it can log in, navigate, and complete a task inside any system your team can access.
lets your Decagon agent access and complete tasks inside systems where there isn’t a traditional integration available
Intelligent email that understands context, stays on brand, and handles complex customer threads.
